component.name: UniPkg
component.summary: One place for APT, Debian, Flatpak and Snap packages

description.p: UniPkg is a universal package manager for Debian and Ubuntu based systems. It shows every application installed on your computer — no matter whether it came from APT, a downloaded .deb file, Flatpak or Snap — in a single list.

ul.li: Filter and sort by name, developer, package type, source, permissions and size
Review and change permissions such as network, notifications, files, camera and devices
Search all formats at once and compare size, sandboxing and verification before installing
Update one app or everything at once
Uninstall packages and delete their data
Manage APT repositories, PPAs and Flatpak remotes
Verify that packages are legit: repository signatures, signing keys, store assertions and file checksums
